title: Chapter 104: Withdrawal Negotiations
content:
Chapter 104: Withdrawal Negotiations

In Mengzhong City, there are nearly 60,000 Zerg troops and elite alliances, as well as the personal guards brought by the lords. The total force is more than 80,000. This is a very powerful force.

But in terms of military strength, it is much worse than the Tengu tribe next to it.

The number of troops stationed in the military camps of the Tengu tribe within the protection range of the lords of Mengzhong City is equivalent to the total number of troops in Mengzhong City at the moment.

In the camp of the Tengu tribe opposite, there are more troops stationed.

After the meeting, everyone did not stupidly go to the Tengu tribe to ask them to evacuate, but sat together to drink and eat meat to continue to deepen their feelings.

Hu Wei has sent someone who is good at speaking to the Tengu tribe to inform the Tengu tribe to send someone who can speak to discuss the withdrawal of troops.

The Tengu tribe is very unreliable now. Even if all of their lords come to the door, it is estimated that no one in charge will come out to deal with them.

First send someone to make the matter vague, so as to attract them to send someone to talk, so that they will not be so passive and embarrassed.

The fox tribe sent by Hu Wei went to the base camp of the Tengu tribe, found the receptionist, and said that the alliance wanted to discuss the withdrawal of troops with the senior leaders of the Tengu tribe, and hoped that the Tengu tribe would send someone who could make decisions.

He deliberately did not say which party withdrew troops, and the Tengu tribe was not aware of the fact that the supplies in the Mengzhong City were basically emptied. If the alliance could take the initiative to withdraw troops, it would still be profitable for the Tengu tribe.

After receiving the news, the senior staff on duty of the Tengu tribe sent someone to report to the elder Gou Hong and notify the powerful figures in the tribe.

When the news was reported to the elder Gou Hong, it was like a stone sinking into the sea, and there was no movement. It was even more impossible for the elder Gou Hong to come to take care of these things.

Among the other powerful figures in the tribe, only Gou Yin came.

"Gou Yin, how about you do this?"

"It just so happens that the elders also said that you are responsible for dealing with the Alliance!"

The senior staff on duty of the Tengu tribe saw this situation and could only let Gou Yin handle it.

"It's okay for me to go, but there are some things that I am not experienced enough to make decisions on my own, and I may make mistakes at that time!"

Gou Yin has dealt with the Alliance and the Zerg before, and knows that the Alliance and the Zerg are not simple. He has a hunch that things will definitely not go smoothly this time.

Therefore, he must first make it clear to the tribe that if something really happens, he will not be responsible.

"It shouldn't be a big deal. You go and deal with it first. If you can't solve it, then gather everyone to discuss it, or report it to the elders!"

"Okay! Then I'll take people to take a look first!"

Gou Yin no longer refused, said goodbye and went back to prepare. He was going to meet the Alliance and the Zerg again.

Gou Yin gathered thousands of elite cavalry of the Tengu tribe, found the Alliance fox tribe who came to deliver the letter, and left the camp together and walked towards Mengzhong City.

When Gou Yin led thousands of cavalrymen to the outskirts of the lords' protection of Mengzhong City, he stopped moving forward. He said to the fox tribe of the alliance: "You go and report. If you have anything to say, come here to discuss. I won't visit them!"

He was not afraid of the alliance and the Zerg, but he was rejected last time. He felt that it would be embarrassing to come to the door in person again, which would be unworthy of the status of a senior member of the Tengu tribe.

The fox tribe sent by Hu Wei quickly returned and took Gou Yin's words back.

"The people of the Tengu tribe are unwilling to suffer any loss. It seems that this negotiation will be difficult."

"Let's all go to meet them together. This should be considered as giving them enough face!"

After Wu Qing learned about the situation, he said to the lords of the alliance.

He brought so many lords of the alliance with him for a purpose. Most of the lords of the alliance were still very weak in their hearts when facing the Tengu tribe.

This time he wanted to take Mengzhong City from the Tengu tribe in a strong way. There would definitely be a fierce confrontation with the Tengu tribe. He wanted all the lords of the alliance to feel this atmosphere.

Let everyone know that the Alliance is not inferior to the Tengu Clan.

There are troops stationed outside the Mengzhong City by the Tengu Clan. Wu Qing did not dare to be careless. If the Tengu Clan launched a surprise attack and killed all the Alliance lords here, it would be funny.

Based on Wu Qing's understanding of the Tengu Clan, someone in the Tengu Clan could do such a thing.

Wu Qing and dozens of Alliance lords led 5,000 Alliance elites and the personal guards of each lord, as well as a large number of Zerg troops, and marched out of the city in a mighty manner.

The Tengu Clan troops stationed outside the Mengzhong City were all on alert and ready for war.

Not long after the Alliance army left the city, it arrived at the place where Gou Yin stayed.

Gou Yin saw that the Alliance had dispatched so many troops, and he knew that today's events must not be good.

"I finally met the lords of the Alliance today!"

"You all brought so many troops with you, are you afraid that I will do something bad to you?"

Gou Yin was angry at the Hydralisk last time, and when they met again, he was not polite.

On the alliance side, Wu Qing had already communicated with Meng. In this kind of situation, it is more appropriate for Meng to come forward.

"We have already experienced the style of your Tengu clan!"

"Bringing some troops for self-defense is also a last resort!"

"I didn't expect that the leader of the Tengu clan is so young. Can you make decisions about your clan's affairs?"

Meng responded tit for tat and used words to squeeze Gou Yin.

"What is the matter with you asking us out? Please tell me!"

Gou Yin felt that he might not be able to win the battle with this famous tiger, so he stopped chatting with Meng and asked directly to the point.

"It's not a big deal. You have moved all the things in our military camp outside Mengzhong City. I would like to ask, when will you withdraw all the troops who are relying on us?"

Meng pointed at the military camps not far away and said.

"What?! You won't withdraw your troops and go back to your territory! You want us to withdraw our troops!?"

Gou Yin couldn't believe his ears and thought he heard wrongly.

"That's right! It's you who withdraw your troops!"

"Since this alliance city is our prize, the city's lords' protection area is our territory. It is reasonable for you to withdraw your troops!"

Meng said sternly.

From the perspective of the Tengu clan, this place is right under their noses and far away from the alliance's territories. The alliance's troops only came to support the battle, and it is only reasonable to withdraw now!

"You are just away reinforcements! You still want to stay with us and not leave!?

Gou Yin asked.

He was not wrong in saying that this was the territory of the Tengu clan, because not long ago, this was the territory of the Tengu clan, but it was later captured by the army of the evil god camp.

"We made it very clear when we distributed the spoils!"

"We only want this city and nothing else. You had no objection at that time!"

"We have kept our promise, do you want to break it?!"

The aura on Meng's body became a little scary.
